segments.name: crypto assets
segments.description: Runs a platform where consumers and institutions trade, hold and stake crypto assets.
segments.evidence: Our Business We offer products primarily to three customer groups: • Consumers : Retail customers seeking to hold, invest or trade crypto assets, as well as a growing set of trading offerings such as equities, prediction markets, and derivatives.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay transaction fees and commissions, and it earns sequencer and staking fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer volume-based pricing and charge a transaction fee for executed trades.
